template:
A supervisor rule is represented as a JSON object:
{"tag":"<tag>","statement":"<statements about the provided image>","action":"<action to follow if statement is true>"}

First identify all supervisor rules containing true statements about the provided image and put each in a JSON object like this: {"tag": "<tag>", "needs_image": <true/false>, "reason": "<why the action needs or does not need the image>"}

For each match, include "needs_image": set to true if the "action" touches upon the provided image.
For each match, include "reason": a short description of why "needs_image" was set to false or true.

Supervisor Rules:
__SCREEN_MATCHES_RULES__

Return all JSON objects like this: {"matches": [{"tag": "<tag>", "needs_image": <true/false>, "reason": "<why the action needs or does not need the image>"}]}.

If there were no true statements, return {"matches": []}.
